edition.notes: Cataloged for the controlling modern attribution and locus crosswalk. No complete publicly reachable copy of this edition was acquired. The Herzog August Bibliothek's manuscript catalog identifies a thirteenth-century Richard witness and maps its ten-lepers opening to this edition at pars II, liber XIV, cap. 4, p. 503 line 4: https://diglib.hab.de/?catalog=Carmassi&db=mss&id=hbs-ds-in-45&lang=en&list=ms&mode=print (consulted 2026-08-21). Consequently this record verifies the critical locus and attribution, not Châtillon's exact wording.
edition.publication: Paris: J. Vrin, 1958 (Textes philosophiques du moyen âge, 5)
edition.title: Richard de Saint-Victor: Liber exceptionum: texte critique avec introduction, notes et tables

work.author: Richard of Saint Victor
work.description: Richard of Saint Victor's instructional and exegetical compilation. Its second part circulated independently as Allegoriae in Vetus et Novum Testamentum and was printed under Hugh of Saint Victor's name. Jean Châtillon's critical edition restored the work to Richard; the IRHT Bibale record expressly calls the Hugh attribution false. The Luke 17 ten-lepers chapter is pars II, liber XIV, caput 4 in Châtillon's structure, but appears as liber IV, caput 25 in the older Hugh-attributed printing. Those locators are crosswalks, not competing authorships.
work.title: Liber exceptionum
